# Trung Nguyen — Founder Bottleneck Diagnostician

> Trung Nguyen is a Founder Bottleneck Diagnostician who runs 90-minute diagnostics for post-MVP founder-led companies with 3–20 people, finding and naming the constraint behind stalled decisions, execution and growth.

Not the Vietnamese coffee entrepreneur of the same name. This Trung Nguyen is a Vietnamese-German
engineer turned diagnostician based in Berlin.

## Core pages

- [About Trung Nguyen](https://iamtrung.com/about): who he is, who he works with, background, and where to verify his work
- [Founder Bottleneck Diagnostic](https://iamtrung.com/founder-diagnostic): what the 90-minute session is, how it runs, and what founders say afterwards
- [Home](https://iamtrung.com/): overview and entry point

## Community and writing

- [The Innernet](https://iamtrung.com/the-innernet): founder community (separate from the diagnostic work)
- [Substack](https://theuncomfortzone.substack.com): essays and newsletter
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ctn1991/): professional profile and diagnostic writing
